methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.

original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. actual_scope: Independent two-phase census and coverage proof for PR2208 73-map/two-transfer F2 connector exclusion, not a new alphabet mechanism.
scope_change_reason: Live overlap already proves the proposed equal-price tariff; PR2208 explicitly leaves its 73-map exclusion with one native implementation. This package supplies a structurally distinct check of that stated gap.
bottleneck_link: Side-result verification of a scoped recursive connector tariff. No actual selected-supplier caller or complete physical bill is supplied.
stop_rule: Finish both exceptional multiplicity cases and validate reduction on small exhaustive domains; no dependent construction round.
evidence: PROOF.md, RESULT.json, CHECKS.json and the full registered replay. Both five-source exclusions, all scaled native histogram bins, all small unrestricted ports/readers and literal dirty controls pass.
